summaryMarkdown: Meeting **Meeting on Aug 20, 05:28 PM** completed with 14 spoken turns across You, Sarah Chen (Lead PM), David Miller (Head of Eng).

actionItems.task: Let us confirm the launch checklist and make sure the action items are assigned with clear deadlines.
I will coordinate the beta onboarding documentation and sample templates by Tuesday.
I will wrap up the final WASAPI loopback device change listener and notarization steps.

transcript.speaker: You
transcript.text: Welcome everyone! Thanks for joining today’s sync on the alpha release.

transcript.speaker: Sarah Chen (Lead PM)
transcript.text: Happy to be here! The response to the bot-free architecture has been outstanding across our initial test users.

transcript.speaker: David Miller (Head of Eng)
transcript.text: The native audio capture layer is operating at under 2.5% CPU overhead on both macOS and Windows builds.

transcript.speaker: You
transcript.text: That satisfies our performance requirement. What is the current status of on-device WhisperKit integration?

transcript.speaker: David Miller (Head of Eng)
transcript.text: WhisperKit runs directly on the Apple Neural Engine. Zero cloud data transmission for speech-to-text.

transcript.speaker: Sarah Chen (Lead PM)
transcript.text: And for summaries, we support Claude 3.5 Sonnet out of the box, with local Ollama for air-gapped corporate deployments.

transcript.speaker: You
transcript.text: Let us confirm the launch checklist and make sure the action items are assigned with clear deadlines.

transcript.speaker: Sarah Chen (Lead PM)
transcript.text: I will coordinate the beta onboarding documentation and sample templates by Tuesday.

transcript.speaker: David Miller (Head of Eng)
transcript.text: I will wrap up the final WASAPI loopback device change listener and notarization steps.

transcript.speaker: You
transcript.text: Excellent progress everyone. Let us wrap up and get these notes distributed.
